title: Jonah and the Clock
author: Kestrel Amberdale
blurb: Silas Almeida, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
